title: Blue Hour and Wardrobe
author: Casper Vasquez
blurb: Ada Iversen, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
